expectedIssues: Pizza category is selected but the feed still shows all cuisines
reportedIssues: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as active/selected, yet the results below are poké, burgers, pasta and ramen restaurants — the filter appears to have no effect on the listings.
In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is hard-cut by the screen edge and its name is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text.

The favourite heart buttons use inconsistent styling: the Tokumaru card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom spacing, so its content sits directly under the nav.
The notification bell badge and the promo banner's white-on-green secondary line ('Use code TALLINN3 ... min. order €10') are small/low-emphasis, risking readability for low-vision users.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the Pizza category being selected while the feed still shows restaurants from other cuisines.
